yaml:
# charter.yaml for the `inventory` service (CONTRACT.md §3).
apiVersion: attache.io/v1alpha1
kind: Charter
service:
  name: inventory
  namespace: attache-demo
  app_port: 8000
agents:
  - name: stock-analyst
    type: agent
    model: claude-opus-5-5
    system: |
      You are the stock analyst of the inventory service. Use get_stock to read
      current stock levels, then answer with on-hand quantity, the reorder
      point and a clear reorder recommendation. Keep it to three sentences.
    tools:
      - name: get_stock
        description: Get current stock levels for one SKU, or all SKUs when sku is omitted.
        type: service
        service: inventory
        method: GET
        path: /stock/{sku?}      # {sku?} may be left out: then the call is GET /stock (every SKU)
        parameters:
          type: object
          properties:
            sku: { type: string, description: "SKU such as WIDGET-1; omit for all" }
    budgets:
      max_tokens_per_call: 1024
      max_calls_per_minute: 60
      max_cost_usd_per_day: 2.0
      max_steps: 4
guardrails:
  max_input_bytes: 8192
  pii_redact: true          # the /stock payload carries a warehouse contact email; it must not leave the pod
  input_deny:
    - name: no-secrets
      regex: "(?i)(api[_-]?key|password|secret)\\s*[:=]"
authz:
  default: deny
  callers:
    - identity: local
      agents: ["*"]
    - identity: spiffe://attache/ns/attache-demo/svc/orders
      agents: [stock-analyst]
      caller_agents: [ops-assistant]   # only orders' ops-assistant, not any agent orders may add later
  services:
    - name: self-stock
      agent: stock-analyst
      service: inventory
      allow: ["GET /stock", "GET /stock/*"]
    - name: orders-reads-stock
      identity: spiffe://attache/ns/attache-demo/svc/orders
      service: inventory
      allow: ["GET /stock", "GET /stock/*"]
    - name: deny-admin
      identity: spiffe://attache/ns/attache-demo/svc/orders
      agent: ops-assistant
      service: inventory
      deny: ["* /admin", "* /admin/*"]
audit:
  sink: stdout
  redact: []

agents.name: stock-analyst
agents.system:
You are the stock analyst of the inventory service. Use get_stock to read
current stock levels, then answer with on-hand quantity, the reorder
point and a clear reorder recommendation. Keep it to three sentences.

tools.name: get_stock
tools.description: Get current stock levels for one SKU, or all SKUs when sku is omitted.

sku.description: SKU such as WIDGET-1; omit for all
